_comment: A source manifest. Provenance is declared here, per source, and the loader
stamps it onto every document it produces. Nothing infers a licence from a
path, because that inference is exactly what the provenance stage exists to
licence_evidence must be one of: spdx-file, repo-metadata, declared-by-source.
The default, 'assumed', is refused by the provenance stage on purpose -- an
assumed licence is an unstated one, and the record is dropped rather than
This file is an example. Copy it outside the repository and point --sources
at your copy; real corpus paths do not belong in a public tree.
